description: List the active email (mailing) lists in the account with member counts (active, bounced, removed, unsubscribed), custom field definitions and preferences, plus paging info. A cheap way to confirm the API key works and to find list IDs. Moosend: GET /lists/{Page}/{PageSize}.json.

sort_by.description: Property to sort by. Default CreatedOn.
